axes.name: Prominence follows importance: size
axes.definition: Kendall tau-b between each element's purpose rank and its size (tallest glyph or control, dp).

measurement.inputs: render PNG + probe JSON; elements = Tesseract OCR word boxes assigned to sections via section: probes, controls from el:/round: probes; ranks from ELEMENTS (design/scratch-2026-10-08/inventory.md)
measurement.formula: size = OCR box height (text) or ink span height (control) / D; per element max over boxes; tau_b(-rank, round(size/QUANT))
measurement.constants: QUANT size 2.0 dp; INK_DE 15 (CIE76); TITLE_DP 55; below-nav or no-ink element = 0

axes.render_folder: scratch (also placement, scratchfix, scratchcalib via fs.visual)

axes.name: Prominence follows importance: weight
axes.definition: tau-b between purpose rank and stroke weight.

measurement.formula: stroke = 2*ink_px/perimeter_px; weight = stroke/height; weight of the element's tallest box

axes.name: Prominence follows importance: colour
axes.definition: tau-b between purpose rank and CIEDE2000 between the element's median ink and its own background.

measurement.inputs: as fs.vis_size; background = box mode colour (text) or 2-5dp ring median (control)

axes.name: Prominence follows importance: squint
axes.definition: tau-b between purpose rank and squint salience: largest blurred-lightness difference inside the element from the page ground.

measurement.formula: L* channel GaussianBlur(SQUINT_DP*D); ground = modal L*; squint = max |blurL - ground| sampled every 2px in element box
measurement.constants: SQUINT_DP 4 (env SCIFIN_SQUINT_DP; audit: same order at 2 and 8dp); QUANT squint 5.0

axes.status: current; the measure that separated the models, and the raw squint values feed inversion/pick/theme_check/glyph_options

axes.name: Visual function axis
axes.definition: Mean of the four prominence taus, averaged over Budget+Activity, light+dark.
axes.render_folder: scratch; reused on placement, scratchfix, scratchcalib

axes.name: Interactive: reference-app placement share
axes.definition: Per control kind, share of observed reference-app placements matching the candidate's; mean over kinds seen.

measurement.inputs: PLACEMENT table (hand-read from Kotlin), REFS table (design/refs-apps captures + controls-dump.txt)

axes.name: Interactive: Material 3 rules
axes.definition: Share of M3 rules that separate candidates which the candidate meets (FAB bottom-end for top action; item action on item).

axes.name: Interactive: familiarity with today's Sci-Fin
axes.definition: Share of the 8 control kinds left where today's build has them.
axes.status: current but biased toward 'today' by definition (audit :471)

axes.name: Interactive function axis
axes.definition: Mean of refs, platform, today.

axes.name: Purpose order
axes.definition: Kendall tau between purpose rank and vertical position of sections.

measurement.formula: tau over sections sorted by y
measurement.direction: higher better (1 = reads in purpose order)

axes.name: Taps to top actions
axes.definition: Taps to start-and-save log-expense and add-to-goal, by action model (typing excluded).

axes.name: Thumb reach
axes.definition: Share of first-screen top-action controls in the lower THUMB_ZONE of the content area.

axes.name: Figures covered by the floating +
axes.definition: Count of el:* figure probes whose box intersects el:fab.

axes.name: Facts on the first screen
axes.definition: OCR money values between status bar and nav bar.

measurement.inputs: PNG only (OCR); reference captures and Sci-Fin renders at 1080x2340
measurement.constants: DENSITY 2.625, TOP_DP 30, BOTTOM_DP 56, Tesseract psm 11 conf>=30

axes.name: Key-figure edge alignment
axes.definition: Share of key figures (height >= median money height) whose left or right edge aligns within ALIGN_DP with another key figure.

axes.name: Competing figure sizes
axes.definition: Distinct key-figure heights in 4dp steps.

axes.name: Density
axes.definition: Share of page content that fits the first phone screen.
axes.status: superseded by function_score/scratch_score framework (2026-10-08); structure S1/S4 left undecided, screens rebuilt 2026-10-09

axes.name: Squint grouping
axes.definition: Each section reads as one shape: a ground band before its title and none inside.

measurement.constants: SQUINT_DP 6, BAND_DP 6, band = blurred row max diff <= 2

axes.name: Entry-point conspicuity
axes.definition: Headline figure's centre-surround conspicuity vs the most conspicuous other same-size window (Itti-Koch idea).

measurement.formula: consp = blur4(|L - blur8(L)|); entry = mean(fig)/max(mean(fig), best other window)

axes.name: Fill purity
axes.definition: A fill should mean 'tap me'.

axes.name: Discoverability
axes.definition: mean(grouping, entry, purity); Pareto with density.

axes.name: Card padding share
axes.definition: Share of filled blocks' height that is top/bottom padding (no ink).

measurement.formula: sum(air)/sum(height) over filled blocks; ink = max channel diff > 40 from block fill

axes.name: Goal + salience margin
axes.definition: Goals' + at least as salient as Income and New goal (squint).

measurement.formula: min over modes of sq[goal_add] - max(sq[income], sq[new_goal])

axes.status: superseded by pick_score bands (2026-10-08 second pass)

axes.name: Elements the switch outshines
axes.definition: Count of more-important elements less salient than the Envelopes/Categories switch by more than one tie step.

measurement.formula: count e (rank<11) with 0 < sq[e] < sq[switch] - Q

axes.name: Savings over floating +
axes.definition: Savings figure more salient than the floating +.
axes.status: superseded by glyph_options margin; owner decision 2026-10-09 accepted + outshining Savings (audit :608)

axes.name: Glyph/label WCAG floors, every palette
axes.definition: Glyphs/underline 3:1 on their fill (1.4.11), switch labels 4.5:1 (1.4.3), worst over 8 palettes from Tokens.kt.

measurement.formula: WCAG relative-luminance ratio, min over palettes

axes.name: Salience band
axes.definition: Both + buttons below Savings and above Income in squint, light and dark (owner's target).

measurement.formula: income < expense < savings and income < goal_add < savings (Budget) and expense < savings (Activity)

axes.name: Strict purpose order
axes.definition: Savings > floating + > goals > goal + > Income in squint.
axes.status: current (misses by 0-2 points, below the 5-point tie step)

axes.name: + glyph on mid-tone fill
axes.definition: Worst + glyph contrast on an Oklab blend fill, over 8 palettes.

measurement.formula: fill = oklab lerp(bg, acc, share); max(cr(acc,fill), cr(onAcc,fill)); min over palettes

axes.name: Band in every theme and mode
axes.definition: pk.bands / pk.strict / inv.switch_above / ss.covered evaluated per theme x mode.

axes.name: Smallest Savings - floating + gap
axes.definition: Per glyph option over 8 theme-mode pairs: band count, smallest Savings - + squint gap, glyph floor, strict count, visual; Pareto.
axes.status: decided 2026-10-09 (option 5), then owner moved + to acc/onAcc

axes.name: Log-income taps, parity, refs share, editor taps
axes.definition: Counted taps from Budget/Activity, Activity parity (§3.6/§3.7), refs share x/7, taps to the full editor; plus fs.visual.
axes.status: superseded by improved_score, then owner decision 2026-10-09

axes.name: Desktop + covered figures and clearance
axes.definition: OCR money words under the + and gap (dp) to nearest figure, read off the no-+ render.

measurement.formula: rect overlap count; min hypot(gap_x, gap_y)

axes.name: Pointer travel Savings -> +
axes.definition: Centre-to-centre distance in dp.

axes.name: Target size vs 48dp
axes.definition: Tap target's smaller side / 48dp, capped at 1.

measurement.inputs: OCR word box (E) or el:note probe (R)

axes.name: Stable default / in place / same pattern
axes.definition: Booleans: default does not change by date; stays in place; reuses an existing disclosure pattern.

axes.name: Fitts index of difficulty to first target
axes.definition: log2(D/W + 1) from the Savings figure to the first thing the pointer must hit; W = target's smaller side.

axes.name: Keystroke-level model time
axes.definition: KLM seconds for 'log EUR 12.50 at Coffee' from the resting screen.

measurement.constants: Card, Moran & Newell 1983: K 0.28, P 1.1, B 0.2, H 0.4, M 1.35

axes.name: Controls added / floats over content
axes.definition: Always-visible controls the option adds; whether it overlays content.

axes.name: Entry sheet span, controls, hidden grammar, taps+keys
axes.definition: Sheet height title-to-buttons (dp), visible controls, hidden-grammar rules, phone taps+keys today/yesterday, desktop KLM.
axes.status: superseded by entry_kinds_score; W sentence built 2026-10-09

axes.name: Capture-line matcher: wrong writes, asks, effort, rules
axes.definition: Over 14 seed-name cases: wrong target writes (must be 0, §4.3), clarifying asks, phone keys+taps, grammar rules to know; with a negative control matcher.

axes.name: Line-everywhere vs W alone, phone taps and desktop KLM
axes.definition: 5 tasks, from the target's screen and away; phone taps, desktop KLM s.

axes.name: Selector vs grouped picker
axes.definition: Taps, scrolls, chips in view (Hick choice time), picker height, rest height for seed and numerous item sets.

measurement.constants: W 332, ROW 48, HEAD 26, AREA 470 px, 7.4 px/char, chip pad 24+6

axes.name: Palette contrast gates
axes.definition: 12 token pairs per palette held to text 4.5, accent 7.0 (AAA), boundary 3.0.

axes.name: Worst accent distance to kept themes
axes.definition: Min CIEDE2000 of a candidate accent to kept themes' accents across modes (near-twin problem).

axes.name: Plane separation and accent drift
axes.definition: dE surf/bg, surf2/surf, accent drift from lexicon seed (reported).

axes.name: Switch distance from ground
axes.definition: Minimise dE2000(track,bg)+dE2000(chip,bg) subject to chip-track separation >= today, labels 4.5:1, dark chip lighter than ground.

measurement.formula: enumerated OKLCH grid L0±0.16 step .004, C 0-.04

axes.name: + glyph contrast on Oklab fill
axes.definition: Best palette role glyph on the fill, else lightness search at accent hue.

measurement.formula: fill = blend(bg, acc, 0.40); max role contrast

axes.status: current for goal +; floating + moved to acc/onAcc 2026-10-09

axes.name: WCAG ratio per token pair (alpha composited)
axes.definition: 19 fg/ground pairs per palette, alpha tokens composited over the ground first.
axes.status: superseded by palette_derive gates + TokenContrastTest (2026-10-07 themes)

axes.name: Mean on-screen chroma (accent visibility)
axes.definition: Mean chroma across a palette's device screenshots (craftkit analyse); ~0 = greyscale UI.

axes.name: Card vs page luminance ratio
axes.definition: surf/bg contrast ratio as card separation.

axes.name: Type ramp hierarchy clarity
axes.definition: designkit hierarchy_clarity over candidate type ramps.

axes.name: Co-visibility census (figures, bars, ranked rows)
axes.definition: A second column is admissible when both views render no ranked rows and no more figures+bars than Budget's two columns.

measurement.formula: counts per view vs Budget 19 figures / 6 bars

axes.name: Heading spacing ratio and fill dE
axes.definition: Space above vs below a heading (refs: sections >= 2x item gap); dE between card/row/note/page fills.

measurement.direction: spacing ratio >= 2 target; fill dE higher

axes.name: app-register-layout register_fit
axes.definition: Skill engine score of candidate layouts.

axes.name: Status-bar icon distinctness / legibility / identity
axes.definition: D = 1 - max IoU of filled silhouette vs real status-bar icons; L = share of parts still separate at 24px; I = matches home-tab glyph; all weightings on a 0.05 grid enumerated.

measurement.formula: 24x24 silhouettes, flood-fill envelope, IoU; connected parts

notes: As of 2026-10-14 NO render folder exists under native/shared/build (only classes/generated/intermediates/kotlin/libs/outputs/processedResources/reports/test-results/tmp, all dated 2026-10-11): the 2026-10-11 tidy (audit-2026-09-25.md:766) recycled every native/*/build, and the tests that wrote every folder the pixel scorers read (Scratch/Placement/ScratchFix/ScratchCalib/Structure2RenderTest) are no longer in source. So every pixel scorer (function_score visual, scratch_score, refs_score on Sci-Fin, structure_score, element_heights, inversion/pick/theme_check/glyph_options, placement/improved/desktop_score) needs a new render test before it can run; only design/refs-apps (reference captures) survives. The probe hooks still exist in production composables (Ledger.kt:55 el:*, Controls.kt:109 round:*, :234 section:*, Rows.kt:236 el:add:*, fill:info) and MeasureRenderTest shows the pattern for writing them (density 1). Pixel scorers assume density 2.625 (scratch_score.D) or 2 (structure); a new writer should restore the 1080x2340 / 2.625 geometry or parameterise D. Newest scoring date: 2026-10-09/10 (placement, desktop, entry, theme_check, glyph_options; status icon 2026-10-10). speccheck.py and selftest.py are spec-consistency gates, not screen axes. Tesseract path and designkit plugin path are hard-coded external dependencies. Many axes are counted from flows rather than measured (taps, KLM operators, refs shares).
